confirmed_claims: SELFTEST.md claims hold when re-run: the full catalogue (124 checks) passes against the reference on darwin-arm64 and in the linux-arm64 container. 107/107 reference mutations are caught on each platform where the condition is observable. Both harness canary mutations trip exit 3. No flaky checks across 2 baselines per platform.
Every check id maps to a valid contract clause (§1-§6 or §N/K1..K16, K3a; harness checks labelled 'harness'), and the README catalogue matches --list-md exactly.

Environment isolation for the binary under test works: the environment is built from scratch, HOME, TMPDIR and cwd are a private /tmp/hmg02-* sandbox, the harness's SSH_AUTH_SOCK is not passed (verified with a sentinel), and the per-run canary is in HM_G02_SECRET_ENV. The fake agent gets PATH and LANG only. Keys come from /usr/bin/ssh-keygen with HOME set to the key dir, and private halves are deleted.
The canary self-check works on the current harness: no full canary value appeared in any record or artifact from this review's 30+ harness runs (32221 files scanned).

Platform gating does not skip silently: a missing pyte gives 'skipped', exit 1 and status in_progress. K3a is a gating ECONNRESET precondition on Linux and a documented non-gating observation on Darwin. The run_double_signal and agent_reset_unhandled mutations are proven on the other platform.
The Linux runner isolates as claimed: --network none, uid 10001, --cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges, read-only repo and artifact mounts, digest-pinned base image, arm64 enforced.
Timing bounds have large margins on the reference (SIGINT 3-5 ms vs 500 ms, resize best 3.5 ms vs 100 ms, K15 at most 164 ms / 44 MiB), and best-of-N plus load recording mitigate flakiness.
The harness catches a run wrapper that leaves the tty in raw mode (reviewer mutation run_leaves_tty_raw) through 3 tty-based run checks.

refuted_claims.claim: README 'Contract clause coverage': §2 error results never include the offending value (profile.invalid_*, control_chars_rejected)
refuted_claims.evidence: Value non-echo is checked only for the two canary fixtures and the k2val- markers. The harness passed mutations that echo the invalid port and revision values (type_error_echoes_value), print the malformed TOML source line containing a secret to stderr (malformed_echo_source_line, typical of TOML-crate error snippets), and put another key's value into the schema_version warning (schema_version_warning_echoes_name). All three exited 0 with 124/124 scoped checks passing; probes confirmed the values in the output.

refuted_claims.claim: README: §3 'bounds and malformed replies' are covered (truncated frame, any string length exceeding the remaining frame, ... → AGENT_PROTOCOL_ERROR)
refuted_claims.evidence: No fake-agent mode sends a zero-length frame, a type-12 frame shorter than 5 bytes, or nkeys at most 1024 with fewer keys than declared. Mutants that crash with a traceback and exit 1 on the first two, and return AGENT_OK on the third, all passed the harness (exit 0). Probes: the unmutated reference gives exit 5 AGENT_PROTOCOL_ERROR for each.

Only a silent agent is tested. A per-read timeout passed the harness; against a reply dripped at 1 byte every 150 ms with --timeout-ms 1000 it returned AGENT_OK after 11.1 s (reference: AGENT_UNAVAILABLE at 1.04 s). The default 5000 ms is never exercised: a 60 s default passed.

refuted_claims.claim: README: §4 'signal forwarding, wait for child' covered by run.forward_*, run.explicit_signal_with_tty
refuted_claims.evidence: Every forward check sends exactly one non-SIGWINCH signal. A 'second Ctrl-C/SIGTERM force-quits' wrapper passed; the probe shows the proto exits 130 before the child finishes (reference: 7).

refuted_claims.claim: README: §4 'Child inherits stdin, stdout, stderr' covered by run.stdio_passthrough and the cwd/env checks
refuted_claims.evidence: A wrapper that pipes the child's stdout and stderr and copies them byte-exactly passed every run.* check, including the tty-based ones. The probe shows that under a pty the child's isatty(1) is False (reference: True).
Latency is only recorded; each step waits up to 3 s and nothing gates a bound. A 1.0 s-per-keystroke filter passed (probe: 1007 ms vs 2 ms).

TERM is always xterm-256color, including in common.no_helper_processes. A tmux probe triggered by TERM=tmux-* or screen* passed the harness, and the probe confirms the tmux tripwire runs. An absolute-path /bin/stty execution also passed; that gap is documented.

refuted_claims.claim: README: §1/K11 'no writes outside named paths' via per-invocation assertions
refuted_claims.evidence: Only HOME, TMPDIR and cwd are scanned. The directory of --meta-file is not scanned, so a left-behind meta.json.tmp passed. A hard-coded /tmp write also passed; that gap is documented.

refuted_claims.claim: README: §5 'width < 50 shows only alias' covered by tui.resize_narrow_hides_host
refuted_claims.evidence: Only 40 and 80 columns are tested, so any threshold in (40, 80] passes. Probe: a threshold of 60 hides account@host at 55 columns and still passed the harness.

defects.description: Value non-echo (§1, §2: 'must never include the offending value') is enforced only for the canary fixtures and the K2 markers. Error messages that quote invalid values (port, revision), stderr TOML-error snippets that print the offending source line (which can hold a secret), and warnings that quote other keys' values all pass. This favours stacks whose TOML libraries print source snippets.

defects.description: The binary's PATH is the harness's full PATH (30 entries, including user directories, on this host). Outside common.no_helper_processes a candidate can execute the owner's real tools. The sandbox HOME limits the impact, but the owner environment is not fully excluded.

Weak assertions. (a) invalid_schema_version accepts any warning containing the character '2'. (b) The row-format regex uses \s+ where §5 says two spaces. (c) meta_not_echoed_homelab and generated_valid_variants reject the literal word 'meta' in stderr of a successful run, which could fail a correct implementation that prints a harmless stderr diagnostic (§1 allows diagnostics on stderr).

Whether the missed defect classes exist in the actual Go/Rust/TS prototypes: candidate binaries were not run in this review (outside the task packet).

Reviewer mutations were run through the harness on darwin-arm64 only, not inside the Linux container. They are platform-independent by construction, except that run_pump_output and run_child_new_session would also need a Linux run to confirm.
Timing-bound flakiness for real candidates (Bun/Go/Rust start-up, first frame) under load: measured only against the Python reference.
tui_stty_absolute: miss confirmed through the harness, but not separately probed (it is a documented K16 limitation).
Three leftover /tmp/hmg02-* sandboxes dated 2026-10-02/03 predate this review and come from other runs. I did not inspect or remove them.
summary:
I re-ran the harness self-test on both platforms. It passes on darwin-arm64 and in the linux-arm64 container (exit 0; 124/124 checks twice each; 107/107 reference mutations; 2/2 canary mutations; no flakes). Every check maps to a valid contract clause. Sandboxing holds: HOME, TMPDIR and cwd are private, env is allow-listed, and the harness's SSH_AUTH_SOCK did not leak (tested with a sentinel). No canary values appeared in any of this review's 32k output files.

The mutation set the self-test relies on is not representative, though. Of 21 new realistic defects I injected into a /tmp copy of the reference, the harness caught only 1 (a tty left in raw mode). Independent probes confirmed 18 of the misses as observable defects:
- **Value leaks in errors:** messages that quote invalid values, and malformed-TOML stderr snippets that print the offending line, which can contain a secret.
- **Agent parsing:** crashes (exit 1) on a zero-length frame or a short type-12 frame, and AGENT_OK when nkeys is larger than the keys actually present.
- **Timeouts:** a per-read timeout passes; it held a slow-drip agent 11 s past `--timeout-ms 1000`. The default 5000 ms is never tested.
- **run:** a second signal makes the wrapper exit before the child, and pipe-and-copy stdout/stderr (child not on the tty) passes.
- **K11:** a file left next to `--meta-file` and a write to hard-coded /tmp go undetected.
- **TUI:** any narrow-layout threshold between 40 and 80 columns passes, a missing filter text after Enter passes, and 1 s per filter keystroke passes because the latency check has no gating bound.
- **K16:** a tmux probe triggered by TERM goes undetected.

One more miss (an absolute-path stty call) is a documented limitation. The remaining mutation is not a defect at the measured size.

Separately, 13 existing evidence files written by other agents (9 records from harness v1.0.0, plus 4 g02-go files) still contain full canary values and must be redacted before commit. Contract ambiguities to escalate: a key_blob inner-string overrun, a run child that loses its controlling terminal, and a numeric bound for 'immediate filtering'.

All evidence is in <repo>/tests/evidence/artifacts/review-g02-harness/: selftest-run/, mutations/ (scripts, diffs, compressed records, probe results), envprobe/ and review-summary.json. The mutation scripts are also in /tmp/hm-review-mut. I did not edit the harness; sha256 hashes of the harness files are unchanged.
